questions.stem: 學生跟著醫師、設計師或律師工作一天，好讓自己能更了解這些職業。
questions.answer: Students spend a day working with doctors, designers, or lawyers so that they can understand these careers better.
accepted_answers: Students follow doctors, designers, or lawyers at work for a day so that they can learn more about these jobs.
Students work with doctors, designers, or lawyers for a day so that they are able to know these professions better.

questions.stem: 親身體驗工作很重要，有些學生一天下來就累到改變心意。
questions.answer: It is important to personally experience work; some students get so exhausted that they change their minds after one day.
accepted_answers: It is important to experience a job in person, and after just one day, some students are so tired that they change their minds.
It is very important to experience work for yourself; after a day, some students feel so worn out that they change their minds.

patterns: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞

1.explanation_zh: 「醫師、設計師或律師」三個名詞並列，形式一致都用複數，最後一項前面加 or。「跟著…工作一天」可寫 spend a day working with …（spend + 時間 + V-ing）或 follow … at work for a day。「好讓自己能更了解」表目的，用 so that they can understand … better。
1.strategy_zh: 列舉時注意每一項的詞性、單複數要一致；「好讓…能…」想到 so that + S + can。
hints: 切成四段：學生跟著醫師、設計師或律師／工作一天／好讓自己能／更了解這些職業
標的詞彙：doctor（醫師，L1）、designer（設計師，L3）、lawyer（律師，L1）、day（一天，L1）、understand（了解，L1）、career（職業，L3）
句型框架：S + spend a day V-ing with A, B, or C + so that + S + can + VR …

2.explanation_zh: 「親身體驗工作很重要」主詞是一個動作，英文常用虛主詞 It is important to personally experience work。「一天下來」是 after one day。「累到改變心意」表示程度造成的結果，用 so exhausted (tired) that they change their minds；人覺得累用 tired／exhausted，不用 tiring。
2.strategy_zh: 中文「做某事很＋形容詞」先想 It is + adj. + to VR；「…到（結果）」想 so … that …。
hints: 切成四段：親身體驗工作／很重要／有些學生一天下來／就累到改變心意
標的詞彙：important（重要的，L1）、experience（體驗，L1）、day（一天，L1）、tired／exhausted（累的，L1／L4）、change（改變，L1）、mind（心意，L1）
句型框架：It is important to VR …; S + get + so + adj. + that + S + V …

references: Students spend a day working with doctors, designers, or lawyers so that they can understand these careers better.
Students follow doctors, designers, or lawyers at work for a day so that they can learn more about these jobs.
Students work with doctors, designers, or lawyers for a day so that they are able to know these professions better.

patterns.frame: S + V … so that + S + can + VR …

patterns.label_zh: 平行結構（A, B, or C）
patterns.frame: N1, N2, or N3（同詞性、同為複數）

parts.zh: 學生跟著醫師、設計師或律師
accepted: Students spend a day working with doctors, designers, or lawyers
Students follow doctors, designers, or lawyers
Students work with doctors, designers, or lawyers
Students shadow doctors, designers, or lawyers
Students work alongside doctors, designers, or lawyers

common_errors.wrong: Students follow doctors, designers, or lawyer
common_errors.right: Students follow doctors, designers, or lawyers
common_errors.explanation_zh: 並列的三個名詞要形式一致，都用複數。

common_errors.wrong: Students follow doctor, designer, or lawyer
common_errors.right: Students follow doctors, designers, or lawyers
common_errors.explanation_zh: 可數名詞的單數不能單獨使用；泛指某種職業的人用複數。
「工作一天」是持續一天，用 for a day；work one day 容易被理解成「有一天去工作」。

accepted: so that they are able to

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「好讓自己能…」表目的，用 so that they can，不能寫 let … can。

accepted: have a better understanding of these jobs

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「更了解」寫 understand … better 或 better understand …，不能把 more 放在動詞前面。

traps.literal_error: Students follow doctors for a day to let themselves can understand these careers better.
traps.explanation_zh: 照字面翻「讓自己能」會出現 let … can 的錯誤；表目的用 so that they can。

traps.literal_error: Students follow doctor, designer, or lawyer for a day.
traps.explanation_zh: 泛指某種職業的人用複數，三個名詞形式要一致。

references: It is important to personally experience work; some students get so exhausted that they change their minds after one day.
It is important to experience a job in person, and after just one day, some students are so tired that they change their minds.
It is very important to experience work for yourself; after a day, some students feel so worn out that they change their minds.

patterns.label_zh: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞

patterns.frame: S + be/get + so + adj. + that + S + V

accepted: to experience a job in person

common_errors.right: It is important to personally experience work
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動詞片語不能直接當主詞；用虛主詞 It is important to …，或改成動名詞 Experiencing …。
be 動詞後面用形容詞 important；importance 是名詞（名詞↔形容詞）。
「一天下來」是「經過一天之後」，用 after a day，不要照字面翻 down。

accepted: so exhausted that they change their minds
so tired that they change their minds
so worn out that they change their minds
so tired that they change their mind
so tired that they give up the idea

common_errors.right: so tired that they change their minds
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「累到…」表結果，用 so + 形容詞 + that + 子句，不能用 to 直接接。

common_errors.wrong: so tiring that they change their minds
common_errors.right: so tired that they change their minds
common_errors.explanation_zh: 人感到累用 tired 或 exhausted；tiring 是「令人疲累的」，用來形容工作。

traps.explanation_zh: 中文拿動詞片語當主詞，英文要用虛主詞 It is important to … 或動名詞 Experiencing …。

traps.literal_error: some students get tired to change their minds after one day
traps.explanation_zh: 「…到（結果）」用 so … that …，不能用不定詞 to。

bonus.text: Only after experiencing work in person can students know whether a career really suits them.
bonus.explanation_zh: Only + 副詞片語放句首要倒裝（can students know）；倒裝只當加分寫法，不是本題要求的句型。

2.restructuring_zh: 「親身體驗工作很重要」是動詞片語當主詞，英文改成虛主詞句型 It is important to personally experience work；「累到改變心意」要改成 so exhausted／tired that … 的結果子句。

1.translation: Students work with doctors, designers, or lawyers for a day so that they can understand these professions better.
1.explanation_zh: 「跟著……工作一天」譯 work with … for a day（也可 shadow）；「好讓自己能更了解」用 so that + can + 比較級 better；「職業」譯 professions（也可 jobs／occupations）。

2.translation: Experiencing a job firsthand is important because some students become so tired after just one day that they change their minds.
2.explanation_zh: 「親身體驗工作很重要」用動名詞主詞 Experiencing a job firsthand（也可 It is important to experience …）；兩個分句的關係中文沒寫，判斷為因果，用 because 連接成一句；「累到改變心意」用 so … that；「一天下來」譯 after just one day。連接詞是自己補的，故信心 medium。

issues_zh: （不影響判定）REF2 的 know these professions better 稍不自然，get to know these professions better 或 understand these professions better 較道地。
我的譯文用動名詞主詞 Experiencing a job firsthand is important（gp-gerund-subject，同屬 NFSUBJ 代碼，程式也偵測得到），不是本句指定的虛主詞 It is important to …（gp-it-adj-to）。
第 1 部分 accepted 全是 to … 不定詞寫法、第 2 部分只收 It is (very) important，沒有動名詞主詞的寫法；但本句 common_errors 與 traps 自己都寫「或改成動名詞 Experiencing …」，評分規準前後不一致，所以判 within_accepted=false。
建議：第 1 部分 accepted 補 Experiencing work in person／Experiencing a job firsthand／Personally experiencing work 等，第 2 部分補 is important／is very important，並在 references 加一句動名詞主詞的版本。
（不影響判定）中文兩個分句之間沒有連接詞；我判斷是因果，用 because 連成一句。參考譯文用分號或 and，都可接受。

problems: 第 2 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義

1.translation: Students spend a day working with a doctor, a designer, or a lawyer so that they can understand these professions better.
1.explanation_zh: 「花一天跟著……工作」用 spend a day + V-ing；「好讓自己能更了解」用 so that + can + 比較級 better；「這些職業」用 these professions。

2.translation: Experiencing a job in person is important, and some students are so exhausted by the end of the day that they change their minds.
2.explanation_zh: 兩個分句用 and 連接；「累到改變心意」用 so + 形容詞 + that 子句表結果；「一天下來」譯成 by the end of the day。原文兩個分句之間的因果關係不明顯，所以信心 medium。

issues_zh: 「親身體驗工作很重要」我自然譯成動名詞主詞（Experiencing a job in person is important），沒有用標的句型 NFSUBJ（gp-it-adj-to，虛主詞 It is important to …），所以 used_patterns 不含 NFSUBJ；中文「…很重要」並沒有強制引出虛主詞，題目的 traps 也承認動名詞 Experiencing … 是可行寫法。
參考譯文與各部分 accepted 都只有 It is important to … 的寫法，漏了動名詞主詞，所以 within_accepted 判 false；建議把動名詞主詞補進 accepted，或在中文裡加線索讓虛主詞成為唯一自然選擇。
「一天下來」我譯成 by the end of the day，accepted 只有 after one day／after a day，建議補上 by the end of the day。
第三部分 zh 含「有些學生」，但它的 accepted 只涵蓋「一天下來」，沒有 some students，部分切割與 accepted 對不齊。
